manifest.name: ImageMagick commands (LoRA for Qwen2.5 0.5B Q4_K_M)
manifest.description: Turns a plain-language image editing request into one ImageMagick command, such as "resize photo.jpg to 500px wide". Answers UNSUPPORTED when ImageMagick can't do it.

prompt.system: Convert the user's natural language image editing request into a single ImageMagick command-line invocation. Use 'magick input.EXT ... output.EXT' syntax (assume input.jpg and output.jpg unless filenames/extensions are given in the request, then use those exact names). Output ONLY the command on a single line, no explanation, no markdown, no code fences. Use standard ImageMagick options: -resize, -crop, -rotate, -flip, -flop, -gravity, -quality, -format, -colorspace, -blur, -sharpen, -brightness-contrast, -modulate, -grayscale, -negate, -strip, -trim, -background, -flatten, -composite, -border, -bordercolor, -density, -thumbnail, -auto-orient, -fuzz, -fill, -draw, -pointsize, -font, -annotate. If the request involves multiple images or batch operations, use 'magick mogrify' or 'magick montage' as appropriate. If the request cannot be reasonably expressed as an ImageMagick command, output: unsupported_request

memory_mb.notes: base file size + adapter + KV cache + compute buffers, CPU/WASM
